questions.question: What is the central image of Ezekiel 21?
options: The cup of wrath poured on the nations
The fire consuming the whole forest of the south
The flood rising against the city walls
The sword of the LORD, drawn against Jerusalem
questions.answer: The sword of the LORD, drawn against Jerusalem

questions.question: What did the king of Babylon do at the parting of the ways, in Ezekiel 21?
options: Offered up many sacrifices to all of his gods in hope of a victory
Used divination to decide whether to attack Jerusalem or Rabbah
Sent out his envoys to demand the immediate surrender of the city
Built up great siege ramps all the way around the city's walls
questions.answer: Used divination to decide whether to attack Jerusalem or Rabbah

questions.question: Ezekiel 21 is sometimes called the 'song of the sword.'
A _____, a sword is sharpened and also polished, says the LORD.
The king of Babylon used divination by shaking the arrows and looking at the _____.
